shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin remains steady around $77,000 with robust trading volume but lacks speculative frenzy after a minor price dip.
Ethereum spot ETFs saw a significant $75.94 million net outflow, ending a 10-day streak of inflows.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index has dropped to 39, indicating that market sentiment is currently dominated by fear.
The collapse of US-Iran negotiations has negatively impacted crypto markets, leading to a downturn after a recent rally.
Bitcoin ETFs recorded their ninth consecutive day of inflows, totaling $1.9 billion and signaling strong institutional adoption.
